prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1485; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has sustained injuries from the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment, and we will be presenting a detailed claim on their behalf once the necessary records are assembled.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy held by the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any coverage is disputed.

Finally, please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, police or incident reports, vehicle inspection and repair records, telematics or dash camera data, and any surveillance footage from the parking facility. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later litigation.
